description: Reviewed collections the service keeps in the card database (.disc/disc.db) for the page. Policy as data: a collection added here needs no image; the service checks every record against its declaration and offers one fixed set of operations.

disliked.description: Tracks the owner does not want to hear. The page hides them from shelves and smart playlists; the service skips one that starts playing while no page holds control.

pinned_artists.description: Artists the owner keeps at hand, at the top of Home and of the artist list, shared by every browser.

pinned_albums.description: Albums the owner keeps at hand. The key is the page's album key (a JSON array of the title and, when a title is split, the release).

auto_playlists.description: Automatic playlists the page keeps as M3U lists in the visible Playlists folder (combined-009 external lists), so every browser knows which lists are the page's to rewrite and never touches the owner's own. The key is the list name (its file name without .m3u), fixed when the list is made; an artist list names its artist. A list is drawn again once its period (a day, a week or a month) has passed since the day it was last written (the browser's local date).

external_sources.description: Outside sources the page may ask for lyrics, covers and artist images (owner, 2026-10-01). Every source is off until the owner allows it; 'auto' lets the page ask without a click. The key is the page's source name; 'api_key' is the owner's own key for a source that takes one. The record of a kind ('artist_images') says which images the automatic lookups take: 'auto_photo' and 'auto_background' (owner, 2026-10-02: a background is not always wanted). Like every record here it is readable by any page the gateway admits, so only keys of free, non-billing services belong here.

musicbrainz.description: MusicBrainz identities the owner confirmed for an artist or an album of the collection (owner, 2026-10-01), with a few of their facts, so every browser finds covers and pictures by the same ids without asking again. 'name' is the artist's name as the collection spells it, or the page's album key; 'group' is an album's release group. MusicBrainz core data is CC0.

artist_images.description: The images the owner chose for an artist (owner, 2026-10-01): its photo and a wide background, by their address at the source with the credit and licence the page shows beside them; each browser reads and keeps the bytes itself. 'name' is the artist's name as the collection spells it.

enrichment.description: The library enrichment's decisions (owner, 2026-10-02). For each artist and album a run went through: 'outcome' is what came of it ('identified', 'review' while it waits for the owner's choice, 'missing' when MusicBrainz knew none, 'skipped'), 'run' the run that decided it and 'wrote' what that run wrote (for its undo). A 'run' record keeps a run's settings and 'state', so a closed tab resumes it. 'name' is the artist's name as the collection spells it, the page's album key, or the run's id.
